name: Transaction Document
suggestion: Please upload the transaction document (SPA/APA) to extract key legal and commercial terms.

fields.label: Target Company
fields.prompt: What is the name of the company which the buyer is seeking to acquire? Respond with the company name and legal entity which the buyer is seeking to acquire.

fields.label: Purchase Price
fields.prompt: What is the total purchase price or enterprise value of the transaction? Include currency and any relevant adjustments.

fields.label: Closing Conditions
fields.prompt: List all conditions that must be satisfied prior to closing of the transaction.

fields.label: Key Representations and Warranties
fields.prompt: Summarize the key representations and warranties provided by the seller regarding the target company.

fields.label: Indemnification Provisions
fields.prompt: Describe the indemnification provisions, including survival periods, baskets, and caps.

fields.label: Warranties Repeated?
fields.prompt: Are the warranties repeated at closing? If yes, summarize the key terms.

fields.label: Warranty Limitations
fields.prompt: What are the limitations on warranties? Include any disclaimers or qualifiers.

fields.label: Fundamental Warranties Bring-Down
fields.prompt: Is there a bring-down of fundamental warranties at closing? If yes, describe the terms.

fields.label: Time Limitations for Claims
fields.prompt: What are the time limitations for bringing claims under the agreement?

fields.label: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
fields.prompt: What is the governing law and jurisdiction for disputes under this agreement?
